mechanism.base: Metal answers metal, the old texts say: strike one blade and the one beside it rings at the same pitch. Steel is sharpened on steel, two edges ground together taking a finer line than either could reach alone. Nothing yields in that meeting. Iron piled on iron grows heavier, and an edge with no softer thing to meet has nothing left to cut except its own kind.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Metal, the edge has no weight behind it and every cut costs more than it takes. The line goes thin in the middle. Sleep before you decide anything.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Metal, the blade grinds on itself with nothing to cut and every argument becomes a test of who holds the harder line. Hand the edge one real job this week.

function.definition_catalyst: Metal is your Body, and running thin, it is stamina spent faster than it comes in. You carry less Metal than you use, so you stand alone instead of leaning on a peer and bet big instead of resting. Each time, you pay from a reserve you never stopped to refill.
function.definition_friction: Metal is your Body, and running over, it is will with nowhere to go. There is more Metal in you than you spend, so you trust your own standard more than you hear a peer's. You turn every shared stake into a contest, and over time you win more arguments than you keep friends.
function.advise_catalyst: You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Take rest in first and sleep before the hard decision rather than after it. Let one peer carry a job you could do yourself. Sit out one contest a month on purpose. Eat before you answer the message.
function.advise_friction: Being right is how you stay in charge of yourself. Ship one finished thing to someone above you by their date. Say your plan to someone who can refuse it. Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a deadline: it gives your force a direction and a judge. Let it spend what Metal stores.

candidates.cta_verdict: Your strength is the kind you make alone, so you measure yourself against your own last best rather than against anyone beside you.

catalyst.clause: The edge has no weight behind it and every cut costs more than it takes.

friction.clause: The blade grinds on itself with nothing to cut.
friction.remedy: Hand the edge one real job this week.

unrooted.clause: The self stands without roots: an edge with nothing under it, form held on will alone.
unrooted.remedy: Feed the self. Borrow ground and practice.

excess.clause: Metal this heavy needs water to take the point off, or the edge cuts everything the same.
excess.remedy: Let it flow out: one thing said, one thing shipped.

thin.clause: Metal is a small thing in you, an edge kept short and used only where it counts.
thin.remedy: Keep it that size. Spend the rest elsewhere.

catalyst.clause: The facet wavers: opinions borrowed, standards negotiable, a stone that answers to whoever held it last.
catalyst.remedy: Practice your craft alone until it shines.

friction.clause: The setting seals itself in: so much certainty that nothing else gets past it.

mechanism_yin.base: Like answers like, the classics say: the same note struck twice rings once, and louder. When metal stands beside metal there is no reaction, only reinforcement, ore of one seam, stones off one wheel. Such sameness is strength and its own hazard. Two stones in one box keep each other bright, or scratch each other dull.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the facet wavers: opinions borrowed, standards negotiable, a stone that answers to whoever held it last. Your chart asks you to feed the self. Practice your craft alone until it shines.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the setting seals itself in: so much certainty that nothing else gets past it. Honor the standard, and let one trusted voice through.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Core is your endurance function: the seat where strength is stored and spent. With Metal doubled here, your constitution is tempered steel: slow to tire, slower to bend, holding shape under loads that fold softer frames. Your reserves run deep and cold, and you mistake that for endlessness. The craft is maintenance without occasion: oil the blade before it asks, and let rest keep your temper.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Metal, and here Metal stands with Metal: edge alongside edge, the same ore twice refined. This is a reinforcement rather than a reaction, the part of your chart that is simply more of you. That is why Metal is your Body: the strength you stand on, your stance, your word made physical. Where the other energies act on you, this one just holds the line.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Metal is your Body, and running thin, it is the reserve everything else draws on: sleep, food, recovery, the physical base under your discipline. Yours holds form long after the fuel is low, so you notice depletion late.

Composed, durable, prouder of needing less than is good for you. The push gets finished on standards instead of strength, the cold arrives the day after the deadline, and the crash keeps perfect manners: it always waits until you can afford it least.

Discipline that skips recovery is borrowing, and the interest is physical. Put maintenance on the calendar before it is needed: fixed bedtime, real meals, one full rest day a week. Track energy like money for one month. Treat the first sign of wear as a warning.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Metal is your Body, and running over, it is more physical force than your life currently spends: discipline with no outlet, stamina turning into tension you carry in your shoulders and jaw.

Strong, contained, faintly braced at all times. Rest makes you restless, a hard workout calms you more than a vacation does, and unused strength keeps showing up in disguise: as irritation, as insomnia, as a shortness with people who did nothing wrong.

A body built for effort needs effort to be at peace. Give it a hard weekly outlet, lifting, long walks, manual work. Pair every sitting-heavy day with something physical. When patience runs short, train first and talk after.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: Your judgment holds like your frame does: conclusions struck once and kept, worth re-testing on a schedule.
backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: Decisions become motion fast in you: once judged, a thing is already being done.
